stem:
Fatima copies the feeding diagram shown below from a Class 8 field booklet.

Is the diagram a food chain or a food web, and why?

options.text: A food chain, because any diagram with arrows between living things is called a food chain.
A food web, because more than one feeding path reaches the leopard.
A food chain, because grass is drawn at the bottom so there can be only one sequence.
Neither, because the labels are animal names rather than the word producer or consumer.

teacher.key_rationale: More than one feeding path reaches the leopard, so the diagram is a food web.
